correctness.rationale: The one-coordinate exact Fourier factorization W=Z_1 diag(1,K) Z_1^T has K^{-1}=q^{-1}conj B by character orthogonality. Restricting to independent-support downsets preserves a unitriangular zeta factor and invertible tensor blocks. Summation of the Möbius inverse yields an independence-polynomial weighted inverse entry; a rational-root argument forbids q>=3 extra zeros and the path recurrence supplies the exact binary mod-four cancellation. Determinant follows from tensor determinant exponents. An actual standalone checker verified fourteen exact cyclotomic matrix instances; it is not the infinite proof.
